---

> **TOGAF ADM Note — Phase B–D**: This catalog is the authoritative traceability reference for all Architecture Building Blocks (ABBs) defined within the IAM security domain. Each row maps an ABB to its parent L2 capability, TOGAF phase, status, and paired Reference Architecture Document (RAD).
>
> **ABBs are solution- and vendor-agnostic.** They define *what* architectural capability must exist, not *how* it is implemented. Solution Building Blocks (SBBs) are defined in Phase E–F and are not recorded here.

## Status Vocabulary

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `active` | Approved and available for realization — may reference as binding architectural guidance |
| `draft` | Authored and conformant with the L3 ABB template; under architecture review |
| `planned` | GUID reserved; ABB not yet authored — do not reference in solution designs |
| `deprecated` | Superseded — do not use for new designs |
